metadata.title: The Ultraviolet Catastrophe
metadata.thing: a character warmed by a wall whose glow is the blackbody spectrum
metadata.color_notes: Rayleigh-Jeans runaway = forbidden red #C0392B (the catastrophe). Planck/measured curve = accent Warm Slate #5A5653 (the truth). All other line art = ink #1a1a1a.

beats.start_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = a small friendly character, full body, standing, looking up with curiosity]

beats.narration_text: Everything warm is quietly glowing — your body, a campfire, the sun — all giving off light.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Everything warm is quietly glowing — your body, a campfire, the sun — all giving off light.
beats.new_visual_element: a person warming by a campfire
beats.start_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = a person sitting beside a small campfire, relaxed and warm]
beats.end_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = the person by the campfire, soft glow lines rising from the fire]
beats.video_animation_prompt: the person and campfire draw themselves in stroke by stroke, soft glow lines rise; no hand visible, white background, napkin art doodle style
beats.negative_prompt: hand, fingers, arm, pencil, pen, marker, stylus, writing tool, shadow, paper texture, yellowing, gradient, photorealistic, 3D render, gray shading, color, brush, eraser, artifacts, distortion, camera movement, zoom, pan, wiggle, blur

beats.narration_text: Our best classical theory predicted that glow should blast you with endless ultraviolet — but it doesn't.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Our best classical theory predicted that glow should blast you with endless ultraviolet — but it doesn't.
beats.new_visual_element: a person bracing as ultraviolet ray-lines blast toward them
beats.end_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = the same person bracing, arms up, as many sharp ray-lines blast toward them from one side]
beats.video_animation_prompt: sharp ray-lines draw themselves stroke by stroke blasting toward the person as they brace; no hand visible, white background, napkin art doodle style
beats.negative_prompt: hand, fingers, arm, pencil, pen, marker, stylus, writing tool, shadow, paper texture, yellowing, gradient, photorealistic, 3D render, gray shading, color, brush, eraser, artifacts, distortion, camera movement, zoom, pan, wiggle, blur

beats.narration_text: Plot how brightly an object glows against the frequency of the light it emits.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Plot how brightly an object glows against the frequency of the light it emits.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw x-axis labeled 'frequency' and y-axis labeled 'brightness', stroke-on, ink #1a1a1a, white bg

beats.narration_text: At low frequencies, only a few light-wave patterns fit inside the object.
beats.tts_normalized_text: At low frequencies, only a few light-wave patterns fit inside the object.
beats.new_visual_element: 2-3 small standing-wave arcs near the low-frequency end
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw 3 small sine arcs above the low-frequency region of the x-axis, stroke-on; axes stay locked

beats.narration_text: But the number of possible patterns climbs faster and faster as the frequency rises.
beats.tts_normalized_text: But the number of possible patterns climbs faster and faster as the frequency rises.
beats.new_visual_element: many more arcs packing in toward high frequency; a faint dashed count curve rising as f-squared
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: progressively draw more, tighter arcs left-to-right; overlay a faint dashed 'count grows as f squared' guide rising; existing elements locked

beats.narration_text: Classical physics hands every single pattern the exact same share of energy.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Classical physics hands every single pattern the exact same share of energy.
beats.new_visual_element: equal-height energy bars dropping onto every arc
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: drop an identical-height small bar onto each arc in sequence (same height = equal energy); arcs/axes locked

beats.narration_text: Countless patterns, each fully funded, drive the predicted brightness screaming toward infinity.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Countless patterns, each fully funded, drive the predicted brightness screaming toward infinity.
beats.new_visual_element: the Rayleigh-Jeans curve climbing steeply off the top of the frame (forbidden red)
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: trace the Rayleigh-Jeans curve in forbidden red #C0392B rising ever more steeply and shooting off the top edge; everything else locked

beats.narration_text: But real objects stay calm — their glow rises, peaks, and gently falls.
beats.tts_normalized_text: But real objects stay calm — their glow rises, peaks, and gently falls.
beats.new_visual_element: fresh axes with the faint red runaway as a ghost, plus the measured curve in Warm Slate that rises, peaks, falls
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: redraw axes; show the red runaway faded to a ghost; trace the measured curve in accent Warm Slate #5A5653 (rise-peak-fall) as the contrast

beats.narration_text: The fix is a strange rule: energy comes only in whole chunks, never slivers.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The fix is a strange rule: energy comes only in whole chunks, never slivers.
beats.new_visual_element: a smooth ramp crossed out beside a staircase of discrete equal chunks
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw a smooth ramp, strike it through; draw a staircase of discrete equal chunks beside it (compare: continuous vs quantized)

beats.narration_text: Each chunk costs more at higher frequency — ultraviolet light is wildly expensive.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Each chunk costs more at higher frequency — ultraviolet light is wildly expensive.
beats.new_visual_element: chunks redrawn growing taller with frequency; a price tag on the tallest (UV) chunk
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: chunks grow taller left to right with frequency; draw a price tag on the tallest UV chunk; ramp stays struck

beats.narration_text: The warm object simply cannot afford those costly high-frequency patterns.
beats.tts_normalized_text: The warm object simply cannot afford those costly high-frequency patterns.
beats.new_visual_element: the spectrum's high-frequency wave arcs greying out / going empty
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: redraw axes + arcs; fade the high-frequency arcs to empty grey outlines (unaffordable), low-frequency arcs stay solid ink

beats.narration_text: So the expensive patterns stay empty, and the runaway curve bends back to zero.
beats.tts_normalized_text: So the expensive patterns stay empty, and the runaway curve bends back to zero.
beats.new_visual_element: the red runaway curve bending down to meet the Warm Slate Planck curve
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: animate the red Rayleigh-Jeans curve bending downward and resolving into the Warm Slate Planck curve (rise-peak-fall back to zero); transform

beats.narration_text: That one rule — energy in chunks — lit the fuse of all quantum physics.
beats.tts_normalized_text: That one rule — energy in chunks — lit the fuse of all quantum physics.
beats.new_visual_element: one energy chunk highlighted, settling on the finished Planck curve
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: highlight a single discrete chunk on the curve and hold on the finished Planck curve; clean close

beats.narration_text: Thanks for watching The Ultraviolet Catastrophe — find more Bear's Notes at youtube.com/@NikBearBrown.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Thanks for watching The Ultraviolet Catastrophe. Find more Bear's Notes at YouTube dot com, slash, at Nik Bear Brown.
